page_title: RSO 2-3 VIL | Real Sociedad v Villarreal 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The yellow card goes to Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
90+7' The referee Cesar Soto Grado awards Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) a yellow card.

90+5' 2 - 3 Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 2:3.
90+5' The ball is out of play. Villarreal win a corner kick.
90+4' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
90+4' The corner from Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by the defence.
90+3' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juan Foyth (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
89' Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
89' The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
87' 2 - 2 Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) curls the ball over the defensive wall via a free kick and it flies into the top left corner of the net. What a brilliant technique!
86' Substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) replaces Ayoze Perez.

85' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Real Sociedad win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
85' Sergio Francisco has decided to make a change. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) replaces Takefusa Kubo.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Mikel Goti Lopez (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Brais Mendez.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
83' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Real Sociedad force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
79' The substitution has been made. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) has replaced Tajon Buchanan.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfonso Pedraza leaves the pitch and Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) comes on.
77' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Goncalo Guedes and he is replaced by Gorka Carrera (Real Sociedad).
77' It is time for a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is on for Carlos Soler.
74' The referee is firm and issues Luiz Junior (Villarreal) a deserved yellow card.
73' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
73' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
72' A precise low pass is received by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
70' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
69' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
68' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Parejo (Villarreal) replacing Pape Gueye.
68' A substitution has been made. Gerard Moreno is replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal).
67' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
66' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

65' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the right post, but Luiz Junior has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.

60' 1 - 2 Goal! Great play by Takefusa Kubo releases Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top of the net. 1:2.
57' 0 - 2 Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) for Umar Sadiq.
55' Villarreal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Real Sociedad fail to score from a corner as Luiz Junior (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.

53' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
51' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' The ball is cleared after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Real Sociedad manage to earn a corner.
49' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
49' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) unleashes a sweet first-timer from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper stops the shot with a quick save.
45+3' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Luiz Junior to dive and make a save.
45+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+2' The resulting corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+1' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Luiz Junior pulls off a decent save to thwart him. Real Sociedad win a corner.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
43' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
39' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
36' Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Alfonso Pedraza puts the ball on a plate for Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.
27' Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and makes a call.
25' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
24' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle as Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
22' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
21' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) will miss the next game.
20' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
19' Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
17' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Real Sociedad have a corner.
16' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.

15' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Luiz Junior guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
14' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
8' Real Sociedad keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
5' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
3' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle. Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Real Sociedad will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will officiate today.
